scope: Use the Data Descriptor as the source backbone; all 15 sources audited; source-relative human expression localization across 13 source labels, followed by donor/participant-level within-source inference
exploratory_status: Retrospective cellular analysis after bulk results and earlier historical 70-gene analyses were known; no new score outcomes used to select this protocol
animal_context: Native namespaces and cells retained in audit; species projection required before cross-species CRRM scoring; animal effects not pooled with human inference
annotation: Reuse frozen project canonical lineages; Berg epithelial subtypes imported only through exact full barcode and concordant donor/condition/time; candidate identities retain their evidence status

scoring.input: native source X counts; each cell log1p(10000 * host_gene_count / total_measured_host_counts)
scoring.aggregation: mean normalized log expression per source study, biological unit, cell identity, condition and time; unresolved-unit observations retained for descriptive profiles only
scoring.features: same frozen388 IDs and signs; common measured features within source; no missing-feature imputation
scoring.reference: source study-relative gene means/SD across eligible canonical profiles, with equal total weight for each biological unit; exclude unresolved units in three inferential sources and exclude COVID/Other from PBMC inference scaling
scoring.total_eligibility: >=70% of388 and >=50% of each frozen direction; branches >=5 genes and >=50% nominal membership
scoring.direction: equal per-gene weights with the frozen up/down sign; positive signed change indicates alignment with the experimental response, not activation of every annotated pathway

error_control.total: BH8 across eight declared total-score comparisons; unavailable comparisons retained as P=1 in the family
error_control.branches: BH56 across seven fixed overlapping branches and eight declared comparisons
error_control.additional_components: separate BH16 for IFN-list-overlap and outside-list scores across the eight comparisons
error_control.secondary: Berg bystander/control and infected/bystander; PBMC Severe/Mild; covariate-adjusted PBMC estimates and LCN2 omission each retain separate declared reporting families; no choosing minimum P across methods

inference.primary: paired t for biological-unit contrasts and Welch t for independent participants; pointwise95% t intervals
inference.Berg: first subtract case/control within donor and the same time point; equally average eligible matched-time contrasts within each donor; one inferential observation per donor
inference.sensitivities: exact donor sign flips; patient-label resampling; minimum-cell thresholds15/50; complete common-time comparisons; author-intent population where mapped; no cell-level biological replication

composition.population: 36 Healthy/RSV participants; four common B/T/NK/Monocyte lineages with adequate observed cells in every patient
composition.observed: sample mean score using observed fractions within the four-lineage compartment
composition.standardized: same cell-lineage means weighted by the equal-patient mean healthy lineage composition
composition.uncertainty: stratified patient bootstrap; no causal mediation or exact whole-blood attribution

source_overlap: Berg/Infant_PBMC legacy copies are aliases of the same descriptor source, never additional validation studies; HLCA components retained by original study_id; healthy/history/memory/post-exposure sources keep their original roles
